scope: FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 costume/accessory acquisition-route reconciliation
verification_policy: Separate inventory identity, acquisition evidence, and DLC ownership. Community guides and catalogues are recorded as evidence leads; they do not establish canonical reward conditions unless independently supported.

sources.scope: Six named Chapter 4 CAC outfit/accessory records exposed by a community catalogue
Super Time Patroller Suit and Time Ring of Memories unlock-guide lead
July 10 report of an Extra Mission server-error issue and Offline Lobby workaround

records.name: Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled)'s Clothes / Turtle Hermit Gi (USV Quelled)
records.inventory_evidence: PQ 185 names Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled)'s Clothes; community catalogue separately calls the outfit Turtle Hermit Gi (USV Quelled)
records.identity_equivalence: likely naming correspondence, not promoted to canonical equivalence

records.name: Fu (Ultra Supervillain) Outfit
records.pq_inventory_relationship: PQ 186 separately lists Fu (Ultra Supervillain)'s Clothes and two Set entries; exact identity relationship unresolved

records.name: Super Time Patroller Uniform
records.unlock_guide_lead: A July 8 unlock guide specifically covers the Super Time Patroller Suit and Time Ring of Memories; the accessible description does not establish the exact in-game trigger.

records.name: Fu (Ultra Supervillain) Wig
records.inventory_evidence: Community catalogue identifies it as a Chapter 4 outfit/accessory record
records.note: This record is kept separate from Fu (Ultra Supervillain) Outfit because clothing and accessory identities must not be merged.

records.name: Goku UI (USV Quelled) Wig
records.inventory_evidence: Community catalogue identifies a separate naming variant; relationship to Goku (USV Quelled) Wig is unresolved
records.note: Do not merge this with the PQ 185 Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled) Wig without item-level evidence.

important_new_evidence: A community catalogue published immediately after Chapter 4 lists six main CAC outfit/accessory names: Fu (Ultra Supervillain) Outfit + Wig, Turtle Hermit Gi (USV Quelled), Goku's Old Gi, Super Time Patroller Uniform, Goku (USV Quelled) Wig, and Fu (Power to Overcome) Wig.

A separate catalogue lists Fu (Power to Overcome) Wig, Fu (Ultra Supervillain) Outfit, Fu (Ultra Supervillain) Wig, Goku's Old Gi, Turtle Hermit Gi (USV Quelled), Goku UI (USV Quelled) Wig, and Super Time Patroller Uniform, showing that catalogue naming is not yet sufficient to determine the canonical six-count grouping.

A July 10 community report states that the Chapter 4 Extra Mission 'Beyond the Future They Sought' could fail to award some items after a server error and recommended using the Offline Lobby as a workaround. This is recorded as an issue lead, not proof of a particular outfit's acquisition route.
nonclaims: No exact drop rates are inferred.
No community catalogue name is treated as an official item name when the canonical relationship is unresolved.
The server-error report does not establish which specific item was lost.
research_targets: Obtain item-level evidence for the six official Chapter 4 costume/accessory records.
Resolve whether Goku (USV Quelled) Wig and Goku UI (USV Quelled) Wig are separate records or naming variants.
Resolve whether Fu (Ultra Supervillain) Outfit + Wig represents two inventory records or catalogue shorthand.
Identify the exact acquisition route for Super Time Patroller Uniform and distinguish it from Time Ring of Memories.
Investigate the Extra Mission server-error issue and determine whether affected rewards can be independently identified.
